subject: Demo recap & proposed PoC plan - FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finservcorp.com>, Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Demo recap & proposed PoC plan - FinServCorp

Hi Tom / Elena -

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo and the proposed PoC/evaluation plan so we can align on success criteria, owners, and next steps.

Demo highlights (what we showed):
- Real-time customer support augmentation using Redwood chat + tool calling (knowledge retrieval + invoice lookup).
- Batch document embeddings for fast semantic search across client agreement corpus.
- Cost/latency tradeoff demo: quantized model variant for 2x cheaper inference with negligible quality drop on your sample prompts.

Proposed PoC objective: validate that Redwood can serve FinServCorp's customer-support and contract-search use cases with predictable latency, acceptable cost, and no production data leakage.

Success criteria (draft):
1) Quality: >= 90% relevance on a 100-sample evaluation set (FinServ to provide), measured by your SME labeling.
2) Latency: median response < 300ms for common prompt patterns, 95th < 800ms.
3) Throughput: sustain 20 qps for burst traffic in sandbox.
4) Cost: target inference unit cost <= $0.003 per request for the evaluated model profile.
5) Security: SOC 2+ controls in place; customer-managed KMS for key material during PoC.

PoC plan & timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope, sign PoC SOW.
- Week 1: sandbox provisioning + data ingestion (your sample prompts & docs).
- Weeks 2-3: integration and run evaluation test set.
- Week 4: run full load tests, final evaluation, review results and decide next steps (expand or close).

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (sales, overall PoC lead), Aditya (technical/infrastructure lead)
- FinServCorp: Tom (product), Elena (security/compliance)

Attachments (drafts): FinServ_PoC_Eval_Plan.pdf (detailed eval steps), Pricing_Term_Sheet.xlsx (PoC pricing/discounts).

Next steps - please:
1) Confirm the success criteria above (or propose edits).
2) Confirm willingness to proceed with the proposed 4-week PoC and the sandbox access we described.
3) If you agree, sign the attached PoC SOW or let us know who on your side will own the DocuSign.

Happy to jump on a short call to finalize - available Mon/Wed afternoons PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Marissa - thanks for the clear notes and the plan. A few clarifications from our side before we commit: 

1) Security/compliance: good to hear about SOC 2 and KMS. Can you confirm:
   - Is Redwood able to run the PoC in our preferred AWS us-east-1 region and use our KMS key?
   - Do you provide an interim SOC 2 report or SOC 2 Type II attestation for enterprise PoCs?

2) Success criteria: the quality metric makes sense, but we need to add some business-facing measurements. Proposed additions:
   - Latency: median < 250ms for the 80% of queries that are single-turn support prompts. (We're high-volume on those.)
   - Quality: QA pass rate >= 92% on top-100 issues (we'll share labeling guidance).
   - Cost: target spend under $X/day during evaluation - I'll fill exact number after our finance review.

3) Data: we'll provide a 3-month slice of anonymized historical support tickets + 500 internal product documents. Can Redwood confirm ingestion formats you prefer?

4) Timeline: Oct 5- Nov 2 is preferable for our internal calendar (gives us time to prepare the eval set). Can you accommodate a PoC start on Oct 5?

Attached: FinServ_PoC_Eval_Sheet.xlsx (internal evaluation checklist) - the team will populate and return.

If those items are okay, we'll get legal to review the SOW and loop the procurement team. Quick note: procurement will want the PoC SOW and pricing sheet up front.

Thanks - Tom
Tom Reynolds
Senior Product Manager, Customer Experience | FinServCorp
T: +1 (212) 555-0199
